rows.text: At the joint review meeting of the Budget Committees on 10 November 1999, 小渕恵三 (printed ○内閣総理大臣（小渕恵三君）) says that he has that day made a decision as LDP president (今日、自民党の総裁として判断を下した) on the bill in question, to be discussed among the three governing parties.
